summary: This is a documentation page that displays all article series available on the site. It imports styling and components, then renders a title, statistics about the series, an introductory description, cards showing all series, and a button to scroll back to the top.

explanations.1: This YAML frontmatter section provides metadata about the page — its title, whether to hide the table of contents, the hero image, and the author.
explanations.3: This tells the documentation generator not to automatically create a table of contents for this page.
explanations.5: This specifies that 'christophe' is the author of this content.
explanations.8: This imports a CSS file specific to styling series-related components.
explanations.12: This comment tells the markdown linter to ignore certain style rules for this file since we're mixing markdown with React components.
explanations.22: The {" "} is a JSX syntax trick that adds a space in the rendered output — without it, the space would be stripped by the JSX parser.
